name: compute_position
description: Packed extension-position construction with signature compute_position(extend_prefix_lens, extend_seq_lens, extend_seq_lens_sum). extend_seq_lens is [bs] int32 and extend_seq_lens_sum is the total number of packed positions. If extend_prefix_lens has length bs, it supplies the starting prefix per sequence; otherwise each prefix is treated as zero. Compute exclusive cumulative starts from extend_seq_lens, then fill positions[start_i:start_i+len_i] with arange(prefix_i, prefix_i+len_i, dtype=int64). Return newly allocated (positions, start), where positions is int64 [extend_seq_lens_sum] and start is int32 [bs]. Inputs are not modified. The suite exercises 1/16/64/129 sequences, including the empty-prefix case.
